source.title: Säkra häststall – hästens sparkbelastning på inredning och byggnadskonstruktioner
source.quote: 90% of the impacts had a maximum value below 1924 N and the highest one was 8722 N.
source.license: No license stated; one attributed sentence cited

attack_force_n.note: von Wachenfelt, Nilsson and Ventorp 2011, SLU report 2011:20, English conclusions. 1924 N is the level 90% of the roughly 500 recorded kicks stayed under (the report gives no average), so it is a high-end figure, not a typical kick. Stall kicks against a measuring wall, often unprovoked, not fighting; the peak was 8722 N and the authors think horses can kick harder. Range is +/-25%.

attacks_per_s.note: No published attack rate found for this animal; category default.

armor_0_1.note: armor level 1: fur, feathers, or bare skin.

endurance_s.note: Category default (mammal). The gallop distance in the Gallop article is not fighting endurance (D-47).

aggression_0_1.note: aggression level 2: flees first, fights when cornered.

group_tactics_0_1.note: group tactics level 2: lives in groups, but responds to danger by running and kicks alone.

source.title: Air speeds of migrating birds observed by ornithodolite and compared with predictions from flight theory

mass_kg.note: Mean mass of the mallards measured (Table 1, the same row as the top speed). Low and high are the Mallard article's 0.7-1.6 kg range (https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Mallard&oldid=1383243084).

size_m.note: Upper end of the stated range; the source gives no mean.

source.title: Air speeds of migrating birds observed by ornithodolite and compared with predictions from flight theory

top_speed_mps.note: Airspeed in steady flight (Table 1); range is the standard +/-10%. A flight speed, used on every terrain; revisit when the showcases are calibrated.

attack_force_n.note: No measured mallard bite force found; category default. One of the duck's 3 allowed estimates (D-47).

attacks_per_s.note: No published attack rate found for this animal; category default.

reach_m.note: reach = 0.25 x size_m (lunging bite), from size_m.

endurance_s.note: No published figure for how long it can keep fighting; category default.

aggression_0_1.note: aggression level 2: flees first, fights when cornered.

group_tactics_0_1.note: group tactics level 2: gathers in flocks, but each bird acts alone.
